title: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct BF16 on vLLM: one 128GB Spark
slug_note: Audio in and out (Thinker-Talker) at 70.5GB BF16 — the 128GB unified box is the smallest verified lane.

variation.quant_detail: BF16 reference; no official FP8 export was verifiable at the time of writing

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve of the Thinker-Talker stack; streaming text and speech output, capped context

requirements.notes: 70.5GB weights + audio/vision encoders + KV on 128GB unified; does not fit 24GB or 72GB GPU lanes.

steps: Send audio/image/video inputs; responses stream as text and speech

caveats: The card does not state a context length, so long_context is left null and the serve command caps at 32K.
Card metadata lists license 'other' with license_name Apache-2.0; check the repo LICENSE before redistribution.
